sv.title: Julia Walentowicz: ”Ska fira på Sturehof med Bosse”
sv.summary: Trots konkurshot firade Kif Örebro det allsvenska avancemanget som att de vunnit SM-guld. – Vi har sju timmar på bussen nu så det kommer vara som en rullande nattklubb, säger lagkapten Julia Walentowicz till SVT Sport.

en.title: Julia Walentowicz: “Going to celebrate at Sturehof with Bosse”
en.summary: Despite bankruptcy blow, Kif Örebro celebrated their Allsvenskan promotion as if they had won the SM gold. – We have seven hours on the bus now so it will be like a rolling nightclub, says team captain Julia Walentowicz to SVT Sport.
